registers.basis: At the beginning of each opponent's draw step, you draw a card.

deferred.claim: Activate +1 loyalty ability to create a 1/1 blue Illusion creature token
deferred.basis: +1: Create a 1/1 blue Illusion creature token.

deferred.claim: Activate −2 loyalty ability to return up to one targeted artifact or creature per opponent to its owner's hand
deferred.basis: −2: For each opponent, return up to one target artifact or creature that player controls to its owner's hand.

deferred.claim: Activate −6 loyalty ability to draw three cards, then put counters equal to your hand size on each creature you control
deferred.basis: −6: Draw three cards. Then put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
